waybackify bucket [flags] [command]

Bucket-projection ops: push · verify

The object-store projection tier — project the cache root onto a remote
R2 / Fastly bucket and prove the projection is faithful:

  push      emit the bucket-population batch (cap/ objects) for a root
  verify    prove a bucket is a byte-for-byte projection of a root

Run `waybackify bucket <verb> --help` for a verb's full surface.

Flags:
  --help|-h   Show help

Commands:
  push        Emit the bucket-population batch for a cache root
  verify      Verify a bucket is a byte-for-byte projection of a root

part of the wayback mirror tooling
